CHECK_TITLE: Ensure there are no S3 buckets open to Everyone or Any AWS user.
STATUS_EXTENDED: S3 Bucket logs-bucket has public access enabled.
DESCRIPTION: Ensure there are no S3 buckets open to Everyone or Any AWS user.
RISK: Allowing public access to S3 buckets can expose sensitive data to anyone on the internet.
REMEDIATION_RECOMMENDATION_TEXT: You can enable Block Public Access at the bucket level to prevent the exposure of your data stored in S3.

CHECK_TITLE: Ensure MFA is enabled for the root account.
STATUS_EXTENDED: MFA is not enabled for root account.
DESCRIPTION: The root account is the most privileged user in an account. MFA adds an extra layer of protection.
RISK: The root account is the most privileged user in an account. Without MFA it is easier to compromise.
REMEDIATION_RECOMMENDATION_TEXT: Using IAM console navigate to Dashboard and expand Activate MFA on your root account.

CHECK_TITLE: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 to port 22.
STATUS_EXTENDED: Security group sg-0abc has SSH port 22 open to the Internet.
DESCRIPTION: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 to port 22.
RISK: The security group allows unrestricted SSH access which exposes instances to brute force attacks.
REMEDIATION_RECOMMENDATION_TEXT: Restrict SSH ingress to trusted CIDR ranges.
